courtesy: Courtesy translation. In case of discrepancy, the Portuguese version prevails.

consent.title: Your privacy
consent.text: We use essential cookies for the site to work. With your permission, we also use cookies to remember your cart between visits and to show Google maps. Your choice applies to this session.
consent.preferencesText: Choose which categories you allow. You can change your decision at any time using the "Manage cookies" link in the footer. More details in the <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Essential for the site to work: keeping you logged in, account security, the cart during your visit, the language you chose and remembering this choice itself. They cannot be turned off.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Store your cart and chosen collection time on this device so you find them on your next visit. Without them, this data is deleted when you close the browser.

maps.title: Maps (Google Maps)
maps.description: Load interactive Google maps to see farmers and mark delivery and collection points. Google may set its own cookies and collect your IP address.

cookies.p1: Cookies are small files stored in your browser; similar technologies, such as local storage, work in a similar way. We use them under article 5 of Law no. 41/2004: strictly necessary ones need no consent; all others are only used if you allow them.
cookies.p2: We do not use advertising or analytics cookies. Your choice is only stored for the browser session: when you close it, we ask again.

auth.purpose: Keeps you logged in and your account secure.

consent.type: Cookie (or session storage, if cookies are blocked)

sid.type: Cookie (or session storage, if cookies are blocked)
sid.purpose: Identifies the browser session to limit the cart to the current visit.

cart.purpose: Cart contents. Only kept between visits if you allow preferences.

pickupSlot.purpose: Collection time chosen on the product page.

pendingProfile.purpose: Remembers the profile type chosen while registering with Google.

lang.purpose: Site language you chose in the selector (or your browser's, on your first visit).
lang.duration: Persistent, until you change language or clear your browser

google.purpose: Set by Google when Google Maps loads.

fulfillment.purpose: Your choice between farm pickup and home delivery, made on the item page.

deliveryRoute.purpose: The farmer's options on the delivery map (optimised route, return to start).

prev.purpose: Temporary copy of the data above from a previous visit, while you have not yet chosen whether to accept preferences. It is restored if you accept and deleted if you refuse.

animations.purpose: Remembers whether you asked to pause the site's animations.
animations.duration: Persistent, until you turn animations back on or clear your browser

fonts.purpose: Loads the site's fonts from Google, which receives your IP address.
fonts.duration: Stores no data in the browser

cookies.google: Google processes the data collected by Google Maps according to its <link>privacy policy</link>. You can also delete cookies in your browser settings.
cookies.location: On the farmer map and when sorting by distance, you can use your device's location to see the nearest farmers. Your browser asks for permission before sharing it; the location is used only in your browser, for that filter and sorting, and is neither stored nor sent to the platform.
cookies.noChoice: You haven't made a choice this session yet.
